method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Whoever believes in God and the Last Day and does what is righteous has a reward with their Lord, and no fear and no grief, whoever they are.
ideas: Four roads from four directions meeting at one lit farmhouse
A calm walker under a clearing storm with a lit window ahead
People of every age at one long garden table at sunset
A harvest of equal sheaves
A wide meadow where many paths end at one gate

sections.meaning: A pledge is taken with the Mount raised overhead, they turn away and would be losers without God's bounty; those who overstepped the Sabbath were made apes and driven away as a lesson.
ideas: A huge cliff overhanging a small crowd on a plain
Hands gripping a thick book with white knuckles
A line of white stones across a field with footprints crossing it
Apes sitting alone on a crumbling wall at dusk outside a village

sections.meaning: They are told to slaughter a cow and keep asking what kind, making the command harder each time, though it is plain what God asked.
ideas: Villagers laughing behind a farmer who points at a pasture
A cow in a pasture with a ring of puzzled people
A golden yellow cow glowing in a sunlit field watched by a child
A golden cow's face in warm light
A flawless cow beside an idle plow
A farmer's hand on the flank of a spotless cow

sections.meaning: They blame one another for a killing and God brings out what they hid, giving life to the dead as a sign.
ideas: A circle of people each pointing at the next
A locked chest with light through the keyhole
A dead gray tree with one branch in full blossom
A butterfly emerging from a split cocoon

sections.meaning: Their hearts hardened like stones or harder, though from stones rivers gush, some split and water comes, and some fall down in fear of God.
ideas: A smooth hard stone in an open palm, a dry cracked field behind
A ring of hard gray stones in a dry riverbed with water cutting through
A fallen boulder at the foot of a cliff

sections.meaning: Some of them twist God's words after understanding them, say 'we believe' in front of believers and argue in private, and write the Book with their own hands to sell it for a small price.
ideas: A straight white ribbon twisted into a knot by hands
A man smiling to a group while whispering behind a pillar
A pen writing on a page with coins stacked at the elbow
A printing press feeding out blank sheets while a man counts money

sections.meaning: Whoever earns evil and is surrounded by his fault belongs to the Fire forever; those who believe and do righteous deeds belong to the Garden forever.
ideas: A man in the middle of a ring of his own wreckage
A tally of marks on a wall by a door
A terraced hillside garden at sunset with a path
A sunlit orchard with a bench and a stream
